response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio, AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_line_items_per_order_item FROM (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) AS per_item
